summary_en: BRIDGE International Group authorized acquisition of up to 132,000 shares (3.8% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥211.2 million via market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange from October 6, 2026 to January 31, 2027 to flexibly implement capital policies in response to changing business environment.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 5, 2026, BRIDGE International Group's Board of Directors authorized a treasury stock acquisition program. The company will purchase up to 132,000 ordinary shares, representing a maximum of 3.8% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum total consideration of ¥211.2 million. The acquisition will be executed via market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange during the period from October 6, 2026 to January 31, 2027.

The company stated that this authorization enables flexible implementation of capital policies in response to changes in the operating environment. As of September 30, 2026, the company held 263,979 treasury shares against a total of 3,504,621 issued shares excluding treasury stock.
